hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: Mpámá is a language spoken around Lukolela on the right hand side of the Congo river (**hh:s:Hulstaert:Mpama**, **hh:h:Windels:Mpama**, **hh:h:Sulzmann:Baboma**:553, **hh:h:Hulstaert:Cuvette-Congolaise**). It is counted as a Mongo-Nkundu [lol] dialect in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29, but linguistically, Mpámá is certainly not a Mongo-Nkundu dialect **hh:s:Hulstaert:Mpama**:5, and lexicostatistically too different from its closest relatives to be intelligible to any of them (**hh:hv:Bastinetal:Bantu**:205). See also: Mongo [lol].
